requirement: Force Complete Brief on /ops/wo chooses its CMS and template like a customer's revision instead of a hard-coded Joomla ja_restora

oracle.ref: PR #1487 (fix); fix evidence: Before: insertForcedRevision wrote cms 'joomla' and template {slug: 'ja_restora', cms: 'joomla'} whatever the account or /ops/wo said (#1461 decision, 19/10/2026).
oracle.invariant: S1: the revision has cms emdash, cms_source ops_force, template quickstart tracy-base/emdash-0.x, design tracy, reason pinned. S2: cms wordpress, template quickstart tracy-base/wp7, reason pinned. S3: the action answers 409 TEMPLATE_PIN_UNAVAILABLE, writes no revision and leaves the sources as they were (whole action rolled back). S4: cms emdash, the fallback fit (tracy-base/emdash-0.x here), reason starting pin-missing:tracy-base/emdash-9.x;.
